data.title: Material Design
data.tagline: Use a systematic component language with clear layers and motion
data.description: Material Design is Google's design system for components, layout, color, type, elevation, and motion. Its value is the shared behavior and accessibility guidance, not making every product look like a Google app. Customize it through a consistent theme while keeping states and structure clear.

use: Large interface needing a mature component system
Team that benefits from documented patterns
Rapid product work with accessibility requirements
avoid: Copy default components without matching the product's content
Mix several design systems in one flow
Customize each component independently until the system disappears

data.agentPrompt: Material Design interface, indigo primary color with a restrained pink accent, consistent component tokens, elevation that explains layers, floating action button where appropriate, ripple feedback and clear states
